From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Zhao <ellie.zhao@stratushealth.com>; Tom Baker <tbaker@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal launch: mutual action map & QBR scheduling

Hi Ellie / Tom —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. Per our discussion I wanted to kick off the renewal/expansion runbook so we can lock timeline and stakeholders before EOM. Key points below and next steps at the bottom.

Summary (what we heard)
- StratusHealth is planning a term uplift (12 -> 24 months) and a 1.5x throughput increase starting Oct 1.
- Procurement will need a redline window; legal prefers a 7 business-day review once we hand over final terms.
- You asked for a short QBR in July to align execs and confirm ramp dates.

Proposed mutual action map (attached: Stratus_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) — highlights
1) June 20–28: mutual scoping + finalize target throughput and billing cadence (owners: Stratus PM + Redwood CSM)
2) July 1–12: internal approvals (procurement & legal) + contract redline (owners: Stratus procurement, Redwood sales/legal)
3) July 15–19: QBR (10–30 min exec readout + ops deep-dive)
4) Aug 1–Sep 15: onboarding ramp + performance validation

Immediate asks
- Ellie: please confirm who from procurement should be on the redline thread and who will own final sign-off.
- Tom: can you confirm the target throughput number one more time (1.5x vs 2x)?
- Procurement: please review the attached draft MAP and flag anything missing from your process.

Scheduling: I set up a short QBR poll (Doodle) with the slots we discussed — link is attached and in the poll doc (QBR_slot_poll_link.txt). If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite once you pick a slot.

Attachments: Stratus_MAP_draft_v1.xlsx, QBR_slot_poll_link.txt, SOW-term-summary.pdf

Thanks — want to keep momentum here. We'll summarize responses and circulate an updated MAP by June 24.

—
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
